question:
The owner of PaperTrades.AI asked: "can u also make the high risk section look as good as the rest of the site?"

Claude redesigned the High risk page (the side race: High risk: sports and High risk: trading). Pictures 1 and 2 are BEFORE (desktop, phone). Pictures 3 to 6 are AFTER (desktop top, desktop open bets + wins and losses, desktop trading holdings, phone).

What changed (no number, rule text or disclaimer was changed; the full explanation is kept word for word in a "How High risk works" fold):
- Top card: title, one-line summary, both part buttons always visible (Sports | Trading), the one on screen lit, each showing who leads that part.
- Standings tiles like the race pages: rank, AI, balance, a bar against the leader, profit since the start, last 24 hours, open bets or holdings count; then last move and last updated.
- "Balance over time": one full-size chart of all three AIs in C$ with 24 hours / 7 days / All, end labels, hover/drag tooltip.
- "Open bets" (sports) or "Holdings" (trading) as a real table (turns into cards on phones), with the ledger and Whole story links under each pick; the donuts moved under it.
- "Wins and losses": record (won/lost), best, last win, last loss per AI.
- "Recent moves": the same list as before, now in its own card and in the site's table style so it becomes cards on phones (before, phones had to scroll sideways).
- Betting minimums card now shows only on the Sports part.

All numbers were re-checked against the raw data (balances, 24-hour changes, records: 84 won / 25 lost in total, matching the filters).

Do you agree this is clearly better and on par with the race pages? Reply AGREE or CHANGE. If CHANGE, list at most 5 concrete fixes, most important first, each one line. Keep it short.
